description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. An expensive item arrived crushed; the payer sends a photo and asks for a full refund. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.subject: Floor basket crushed in delivery
messages.body: My floor basket (KIK-1019) arrived completely crushed on one side, it won't stand up. Photo attached. I'd like a full refund please.
